segments: The tenth dynasty.
The Arab kings.
he made a show of reluctance and said,
"Such and such a person is fit, and such and such a person."
They seized him by force,
and made him sit upon the throne of the kingdom.
And nine times they knelt upon their knees and did homage to him,
and they took a cup and made him drink.
And when he was established upon the throne,
he began to govern well,
because he was enlightened and very shrewd.
For the countries of the Romans (Rūm), the Georgians, Assyria, Syria, and Cilicia he committed to one of the chiefs whose name was Ilchikaday (Iljigidey?).
And to the country of Cathay he sent the great amīr Yalvach.
And Persia he gave to the amīr Mas'ud Beg.
And Khurasan, Hamadan, Azerbaijan, Shirvan, Lur, and Kirman as far as India he committed to the amīr Arghun.
And over the Romans (Rūm) he commanded Rukn al-Din to be Sultan.
And King Hethum he sent back with honor;
likewise also the Georgians and the Franks.
And to the Caliph he sent bitter threats;
and the ambassadors of the Ishmaelites (Assassins) he drove away with mockery and contempt.
And because Qadaq the Christian had from the beginning been engaged in his service,
he became the chancellor and administrator.
And this Güyük Khan was a true Christian;
and in his days the horn of many Christians was exalted,
and his camp was filled with bishops, priests, and monks.
At that time a certain Arab (Muslim) woman,
whose name was Fatima Khatun,
was very close and beloved to Töregene Khatun, the mother of Güyük Khan,
and her secret affairs were revealed to her.
And as evil fortune would have it, she was slandered before Güyük Khan,
[they saying], "She is practicing sorcery against you and your brothers."
And he sent and demanded her from his mother.
And when she would not give her up,
he took her from her by force and killed her.
And by this means there arose resentment between him and his mother,
and after a little while his mother also died.
For this Fatima the miller-woman,
after they had left her naked for many days without food and without drink,
they scourged until she confessed that she was a sorceress.
And then they sewed up her upper and lower orifices,
and put her in a felt blanket,
and cast her into the water, and she was drowned.
